Title: Source list
Prompt: List the sources I actually pasted. Do not add famous studies from memory.
Check: Every source is in the paste.

Title: Claims
Prompt: List claims and the source for each. If two sources disagree, show both.

Title: Not established
Prompt: Write what these sources do not establish.

Title: Brief
Prompt: Write a brief: question, what the sources say, what they do not say, what I might do next. Do not add statistics.

Title: Quote check
Prompt: Use a quotation only if it appears in my paste. Otherwise paraphrase and say it is a paraphrase.

Title: Audience cut
Use when: A specific person will read it.
Prompt: Cut the brief for that reader. Remove background they do not need. Do not remove the disagreements.
